question: 매장별 매출을 높은 순서로 알려줘
sql_answer: SELECT store_name, MEASURE(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM cafe_training.cafe_hands_on.cafe_sales_metrics GROUP BY store_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 가장 많이 팔린 메뉴 3개 알려줘
sql_answer: SELECT product_name, MEASURE(item_quantity) AS item_quantity FROM cafe_training.cafe_hands_on.cafe_sales_metrics GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY item_quantity DESC LIMIT 3

question: 카테고리별 순매출을 비교해줘
sql_answer: SELECT category, MEASURE(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM cafe_training.cafe_hands_on.cafe_sales_metrics GROUP BY category ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 날짜별 매출 추이를 보여줘
sql_answer: SELECT order_date, MEASURE(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM cafe_training.cafe_hands_on.cafe_sales_metrics GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date

question: 시간대별 매출과 주문수를 비교해줘
sql_answer: SELECT daypart, MEASURE(net_sales) AS net_sales, MEASURE(order_count) AS order_count FROM cafe_training.cafe_hands_on.cafe_sales_metrics GROUP BY daypart ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 강남점 객단가는 얼마야?
sql_answer: SELECT store_name, MEASURE(avg_order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM cafe_training.cafe_hands_on.cafe_sales_metrics WHERE store_name = '강남점' GROUP BY store_name

question: 주말과 평일의 순매출을 비교해줘
sql_answer: SELECT day_type, MEASURE(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM cafe_training.cafe_hands_on.cafe_sales_metrics GROUP BY day_type ORDER BY net_sales DESC
